reviews.title: Great motherboard
reviews.comment: So far it has been a great motherboard.  Just a couple of things I found in the product description that were a little confusing and the manufacturer's webpage isn't clear either.  One, it does not have graphics built into it, and second there is only one display port, not two.  The Gigabyte Control Center works well when installing updates.  Bios flash worked great, no problems.  Overall the motherboard has been solid, easy to install and setup
reviews.author: Richard Fullerton

reviews.title: Very good Intel board
reviews.comment: This motherboard is great as it has 4 PCIe slots plus the GPU slot. My only issue with this board is the USB 3 connection socket had bent pins. Due to this I could not use my front USB 3 ports on my PC case. Other than that everything is great with this board.
reviews.author: Raphael
